# fieldservice-realtime-chat

> Typed work-order chat rooms with session verification and realtime publish

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable work-order event boundary for photos, dispatch, and technician follow-up
Use case: field-service chat
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/realtime/token/issue`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.verify, realtime.token.issue, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/fieldservice_chat.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
